connect.label: Connect to my AcoustID account
connect.description: Turn this off to use AcoustID without connecting for now. You can connect later with Reconfigure.

reconnect.label: Connect again
reconnect.description: Turn this on to connect again, for example with a different AcoustID account.

user_key_note.label: AcoustID will later require Music Assistant to be connected to your AcoustID account for lookups. Use Reconfigure to connect.

min_score.label: Minimum match score
min_score.description: Confidence threshold (0.5 - 1.0) below which AcoustID matches are discarded. The default of 0.85 is a balance between recall and false-positive rate; raise it for stricter matching.

analyse_streaming.label: Analyse tracks from streaming providers
analyse_streaming.description: When enabled, also fingerprint and identify tracks played from streaming providers (Spotify, Tidal, Qobuz, …) that are present in your library but lack a MusicBrainz Recording Id.

write_tags_back.label: Write AcoustID/MusicBrainz tags back to files
write_tags_back.description: When the audio-analysis scan identifies a track via AcoustID, also write the Acoustid Id, MusicBrainz Recording Id, ISRC, and (where resolvable) MusicBrainz Artist Id tags back into the source audio file. Useful if other apps on your network rely on these tags for their own metadata. Requires a Filesystem music source with write access to the file; read-only files are silently skipped.

user.title: Connect to AcoustID
user.description: Connecting Music Assistant to your AcoustID account is optional for now. AcoustID will require it for lookups later on.

connected.title: Connected to AcoustID
connected.description: Music Assistant is connected to your AcoustID account.

approve.title: Approve Music Assistant
approve.description: Your code is {0}. Use the button below to open AcoustID with the code already filled in, or go to acoustid.org/link on another device and enter the code there. Sign in and approve the connection. This screen updates automatically once you approve.

manifest.description: Identifies local audio files using AcoustID/Chromaprint fingerprinting and fills in their MusicBrainz recording ID for subsequent metadata enrichment.

errors.app_key_refused: AcoustID no longer accepts the key Music Assistant uses for lookups. Lookups are off until Music Assistant is updated.
errors.user_key_missing: AcoustID needs Music Assistant to be connected to your AcoustID account for lookups. Use Reconfigure to connect.
errors.link_declined: The connection was declined on AcoustID.
errors.link_revoked: The connection was removed on AcoustID.
errors.link_unknown: This connection no longer exists on AcoustID.
errors.acoustid_unreachable: AcoustID could not complete the request.
